result.summary: Found 1 major visual/content bug: an untranslated localization key is shown as a section heading. A couple of minor carousel truncation issues are visible but likely expected from horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a human-readable title such as "Popular near you".
issues.suggestion: Fix the missing i18n string/resource for home_feed.popular_title and add a fallback so raw keys are never rendered in production UI.

issues.description: The right-most category chip and restaurant card are clipped at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: If intentional for horizontal scroll, add edge fade/padding to make affordance clearer; otherwise adjust carousel peek spacing so partially visible items look deliberate.
